source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Heart Healthy Home Cooking: African American Style, US Department of Health and Human Services, National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute

steps.instruction: Trim the fat from the 6 pork chops.
Place the chops in a 13x9 inch baking pan.
Spread 1 medium sliced onion over the chops.
Spread 1/2 cup of green pepper and 1/2 cup of red pepper on top.
Sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon of black pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Uncover the pan and turn the chops over.
Cover the chops again with the onions and peppers.
Cook for 15 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 145 °F.
steps.spoken: Cook for 15 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 145 °F in the thickest part of a chop.
